When English-born Mable Lucie Attwell 
was young, she created enchanting 
stories and pictures about children. 

She sold her first illustration ot 16, 

and her first children's book was issued 
in 1905. Throughout her six decade \ 
coreer, she portrayed children їп oll 

their innocence and wisdom, using her 

own daughter, Peggy, as her. 

inspiration. In 1921, she was

INFORMATION ABOUT YOUR SEARS CATALOG ORDER 


save this catalog! 

Unless stated otherwise: You can order any 
item on pages 245 thru 493 at 1989 prices 
thru August 31, 1990; last date to order 
other items is February 15, 1990. Ship-a- 
gift orders for Christmas should be placed 
before December 10. 


keep your catalogs coming 


Our catalogs are our primary means of 
contacting you—our valued customer. If 
you place 3 catalog orders in a 6-month 
period totaling $60, using your Sears- 
Charge, Discover Card or cash, you will 
maintain a place on our catalog mailing list 
and receive many of our catalogs, free of 
charge, throughout the year. 


monthly payments 

If you have an existing SearsCharge or 
SearsCharge PLUS account balance, the 
addition of a specific purchase may or may 
not change your current monthly payment 
depending upon the highest balance of 
your account. Sales tax, delivery or in- 
stallation charges, if any, may cause 
quoted minimum monthly payments to be 
higher. To apply for SearsCharge, call 
TOLL-FREE 1-800-323-3274. 


it's easy to order! 

You can order by mail, in person or by 
phone-the quickest, easiest way! Call 
1-800-366-3000, 24 hours a day, 7 days 
a week. (To check an order, call your local 
Sears store.) 

To order by mail, use the order form on 
page 522B or any piece of plain paper. 
Print your full name and address at the top 
and include all catalog numbers, page 
numbers, item descriptions, quantities 
and price. Also include sizes, colors, etc. 
Mail your order to the nearest address: 
Columbus, OH 43228 
Greensboro, NC 27480 
Jacksonville, FL 32297 
Kansas City, MO 64127 
Catalog merchandise and assortments may 
vary from those found in our retail stores; 
also, Sears retail "competitors advertised 
price pledge" does not apply to catalog. 


Shipping information 

Prices do not include charges for shipping 
and handling, unless otherwise stated. 
These charges are based on the item's 
shipping weight and method of delivery. 
We endeavor to publish accurate weights. 
However, if a mistake is made, you will be 
charged based on actual shipping weight. 
Fractions have been rounded up to the next 
largest whole number on those items whose 
exact dimensions are not necessary. 


store pickup... 
H you've chosen to have your order sent to 


a local Sears store for pickup, phone 
1-800-366-3000 for delivery charges. 








home delivery... 


For no more than $1 over store pickup 
charges, we can send most mailable orders 
to your home, office or anywhere else you 
request in the continental U.S. For credit 
orders, delivery costs are added to your 
account. If you prefer to pay in advance, 
include shipping and handling charges 
plus tax based on the destination of your 
order. Delivery is made by the United 
States Postal Service or United Parcel Ser- 
vice. Sorry, no C.0.D.’s. Sears shipping 
and handling charges below apply to all 
merchandise, except items with a catalog 
number ending in “N”, “NH” or “K”. 








“К” suffix (as 9-7772K). This item is un- 
mailable to AK, HI, TX and Puerto Rico. 
“N”, “NH” suffix (as 37-1234N). This 
item, if shipped directly to your home, is 
sent by motor carrier. Use the average 
rates below to determine approximate 

and charges for non- 
mailable orders delivered in the conti- 
nental U.S. It may be more economical to 
have these items sent to a local Sears store 
for pickup. Use our OrderLine, 
1-800-366-3000, to place your 
order—you'll be quoted delivery charges. 
Delivery service varies by area. Point of 
delivery could be in the home, at the door- 
step or only to the sidewalk; the Customer 
consultant will advise you. 














out of stock policy 


If an item you order is out of stock, we will 
notify you as soon as possible. If we don’t 
think we can fill the order within 30 days, 
we'll ask you if you still want the item 
when it becomes available. In some cases 
where an item is out of stock, we may send 
a substitute of equal or greater value at the 
same price as your original order. If an ap- 
propriate substitute is unavailable, and 
additional stock cannot be obtained, we'll 
cancel your order and issue a full refund. 
The merchandise offered in this book is 
stocked in quantities intended to accom- 
modate only individual or family needs. 
Therefore, we reserve the right to limit 
quantities in order to properly serve all our 
customers.
